scenes.google_flow_prompt: High quality graphical breakdown card displaying Pros vs Cons for PyCharm.
scenes.audio_narration: On the pros side: First-class Python virtualenv, Conda, and Docker container support, Integrated Jupyter Notebook support in Professional edition, Powerful Django/FastAPI/Flask framework debugging and routing tools, Built-in code inspector catching Python PEP8 violations instantly. On the cons side: Heavy resource utilization compared to VS Code Python extension, Professional features locked behind subscription, Initial project indexing time.
